verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a live OpenAPI spec and documents the entire Cloudflare API, over 2,500 endpoints covering DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust and every other product, exposed through its MCP server with OAuth or scoped API-token auth. Wrangler also offers CLI parity for core Workers tasks; rollback, for example, is documented via either Wrangler or the dashboard. missing for 10: an explicit first-party guarantee that every dashboard action has an API equivalent, independent or hands-on corroboration of UI/API parity.
